name: klipper-formatter
description: Rich language support for Klipper configuration files and Klipper-flavored GCode, plus a whitespace-safe formatter and Jinja block diagnostics.
author: Ricky Tsai <ricky@rtnztech.com>

commands.title: Klipper: Format All .cfg Files in Workspace
Klipper: Preview Formatting of All .cfg Files (dry run)
Klipper: Check Jinja Block Balance in Workspace

klipperFormatter.indentSize.markdownDescription: Spaces per indent level inside a multi-line value (a `gcode:` block and friends). This is also the amount each nested Jinja block adds, unless `#klipperFormatter.jinjaIndentSize#` overrides it.

klipperFormatter.jinjaIndentSize.markdownDescription: Extra spaces added per nested Jinja block (`{% if %}`, `{% for %}`, ...). Leave at `0` to use `#klipperFormatter.indentSize#` so the whole tree gets one uniform style. Set to `2` to keep the tighter nesting style some configs use.

klipperFormatter.indentJinjaBlocks.markdownDescription: Indent the body of each `{% if %}` / `{% for %}` block. Turn off to give every line in a value block a single flat indent level.

klipperFormatter.normalizeSeparatorSpaci.markdownDescription: Rewrite `key   : value` as `key: value`. The original separator is kept, so `key = value` files (such as the `variables.cfg` written by `save_variables`) stay on `=`.

klipperFormatter.maxConsecutiveBlankLine.description: Collapse longer runs of blank lines down to this many.

klipperFormatter.blankLinesBeforeSection.markdownDescription: Blank lines to guarantee before a `[section]` header. A comment directly above a header is treated as part of it, and bare adjacent headers stay grouped.

klipperFormatter.trimLeadingBlankLines.description: Remove blank lines at the very top of the file.

klipperFormatter.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Report unbalanced Jinja blocks (a `{% if %}` with no `{% endif %}`, a stray `{% endfor %}`, an unterminated `{% ... %}` tag) as problems.

klipperFormatter.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns excluded from the workspace-wide commands, diagnostics and format-on-save. Example: `["**/mmu/**", "**/timelapse.cfg"]` to leave vendor-managed configs alone.
